fixtureCase.title: Nightly invoice export retry (eval fixture)
fixtureCase.problem: The nightly invoice export to the accounting system failed whenever the accounting API timed out.
fixtureCase.context: Finance depends on the export being complete by 06:00 each day.
fixtureCase.approach: Retry the failed export three times with exponential backoff and then stop.
fixtureCase.observedOutcome: Exports completed after at most one retry in the first month.
fixtureCase.revisedApproach: Retry the failed export five times with exponential backoff, then page the on-call engineer.
